environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application running in a Docker container (node:18-slim base) on ECS Fargate. Container runs as root (uid 0) with default Docker seccomp profile. The /app/data/extracted directory is mounted on an EBS volume. No read-only filesystem constraints. The container has outbound network access for pulling dependencies and connecting to downstream services.

config.network: full outbound access via NAT gateway
